findings.claim: BENCHMARK_22 summary: 22 langs (18 probe22 with 19-100 scored each + South ta 70, te 26, kn 25, ml 5 of 100 labelled). 13 of 22 clear n>=50; 1 below n=10 (ml). Best local engine is surya on 14 of 22 cells (weak on South te/kn/ml); tesseract-family wins mr, or, doi, mni, ne, sat.

Scorer divergence: our metrics.py is a fork of Sarvam's. Ours scores empty predictions and tail loops as CER 1.0 (Sarvam excludes) and drops GT<50-char rows (Sarvam has no floor) - our CER is systematically harsher. No head-to-head vs published 87.39 valid until one scorer.

Sarvam's metrics.py word-split/merge fallback returns gt2,gt2 (substitutes GT for prediction) giving CER 0 on a class of real word-segmentation errors; ours returns gt2,pred2 (correct). A genuine bug inflating Sarvam's score; row count unknown.

Empty-prediction counts over 1,227 scored items (scored as CER 1.0): anuvaad_tesseract 617, rapidocr 343, paddleocr_indic 536, surya 129, easyocr 0. Surya empty on all 100 sa items and 11/20 mni, 4 brx, 4 doi, 3 gu, 3 ne, 2 sat.

Per-language best local engine (mean CER, probe22): surya wins bn 0.476, brx 0.165, gu 0.255, hi 0.220, kok 0.425, ks 0.589, mai 0.030, pa 0.145, sd 0.315, ur 0.623; tesseract_bilingual mr 0.205, ne 0.161; tesseract_indic doi 0.322, mni 0.858, or 0.259; indicphotoocr as 0.189, sat 0.651; easyocr sa 0.175. No engine under 0.4 on bn,kok,ks,ur,mni,sat.

Weakest cells (best local CER): mni 0.858 (tess; surya 0.977, n=20), sat 0.651 (indicphotoocr; surya 0.762, tess 0.878, n=20), ks 0.589, ur 0.623, te 0.634, kn 0.647, ml 0.629 (n=5), bn 0.476 (surya). Sarvam paired n=3: mni 0.023, sat 0.477, sa 0.019, bn 0.089, ks 0.630, ur 0.533.

Paired surya vs Sarvam on mni: surya 1.0000 vs Sarvam 0.0230; sa surya 1.0000 vs Sarvam 0.0195; sat 0.8546 vs 0.4773; bn 0.3412 vs 0.0891; hi 0.2627 vs 0.0836. Sarvam enormously ahead on mni/sa/bn/hi/sat; surya ahead on brx 0.1079 vs 0.3794, mai 0.0242 vs 0.2568, or 0.2303 vs 0.4475.

Bengali (bn) in probe22: 100 gold-pair PRINTED items; surya CER 0.476 mean, tesseract 0.888, IPO 0.657, easy 0.667, all others ~1.0; Sarvam 0.089 (n=3). Bengali printed baseline is weak locally. probe22 is 100% printed so says nothing about handwriting.
